name: Full-depth spatial liquidity concentration v2
upgrade_schema: mbo only if MBP-10 cannot identify the required flux robustly
observations: 30-second lookback windows sampled every 10 seconds from 09:25 through 09:34, with a non-overlapping next-30-second outcome
primary_claim: Full-depth spatial concentration features improve prediction of the next-30-second maximum midpoint excursion beyond top-of-book state, recent volatility, and aggregate order-flow controls.
spatial_features: L-infinity/L2, L4/L2, and L8/L2 flux-over-lagged-depth ratios across twenty side-level cells
first and second price-level gradient energy
inverse participation ratio and effective active-core width
primary_metric: date-clustered out-of-sample average precision for a training-defined 90th-percentile excursion
success_gate: average-precision improvement >= 0.02 on validation and positive on untouched holdout, with a 95% date-cluster bootstrap interval excluding zero on the combined forward sample
kill_gate: negative or immaterial incremental ranking value, effect explained by spread/volatility/top depth, or failure under date and event-time perturbations
purchase_rule: No time-series request may execute until the user approves an explicit USD hard cap greater than or equal to the 125% protected metadata estimate.
non_claims: the empirical transport/replenishment ratio is a physical Reynolds number
a positive statistical result authorizes trading
